options.name: cluster
options.description: IP or FQDN for the Cohesity Cluster

options.name: cohesity_admin
options.description: Username with which Ansible will connect to the Cohesity Cluster. Domain Specific credentails can be configured in following formats AD.domain.com/username AD.domain.com/username@tenant LOCAL/username@tenant

options.name: cohesity_password
options.description: Password belonging to the selected Username. This parameter will not be logged.

options.name: endpoint
options.description: Specifies the network endpoint of the Protection Source where it is reachable. It could be an URL or hostname or an IP address of the Protection Source or a NAS Share/Export Path.

options.name: environment
options.description: Specifies the environment type (such as VMware or SQL) of the Protection Source this Job is protecting. Supported environment types include 'Physical', 'VMware', 'GenericNas'

options.name: force_register
options.description: Enabling this option will force the registration of the Cohesity Protection Source.

options.name: host_type
options.description: Specifies the optional OS type of the Protection Source (such as C(Windows) or C(Linux)). C(Linux) indicates the Linux operating system. C(Windows) indicates the Microsoft Windows operating system. C(Aix) indicates the IBM AIX operating system. Optional when I(state=present) and I(environment=Physical).

options.name: nas_password
options.description: Specifies the password to accessthe target NAS Environment. This parameter will not be logged. Required when I(state=present) and I(environment=GenericNas) and I(nas_protocol=SMB)

options.name: nas_protocol
options.description: Specifies the protocol type of connection for the NAS Mountpoint. SMB Share paths must be in \\server\share format. Required when I(state=present) and I(environment=GenericNas)

options.name: nas_type
options.description: Specifies the type of connection for the NAS Mountpoint.

options.name: nas_username
options.description: Specifies username to access the target NAS Environment. Supported Format is Username or username@domain or Domain/username (will be deprecated in future). Required when I(state=present) and I(environment=GenericNas) and I(nas_protocol=SMB)

options.name: physical_type
options.description: Specifies the entity type such as C(Host) if the I(environment=Physical). C(Host) indicates a single physical server. C(WindowsCluster) indicates a Microsoft Windows cluster. Optional when I(state=present) and I(environment=Physical).

options.name: refresh
options.description: Switch determines whether to refresh the existing source. Applicable only when source is already registered.

options.name: skip_validation
options.description: Switch for source validation during registeration.

options.name: source_password
options.description: Specifies the password to access the target source. This parameter will not be logged. Required when I(state=present) and I(environment=VMware)

options.name: source_username
options.description: Specifies username to access the target source. Required when I(state=present) and I(environment=VMware)

options.name: state
options.description: Determines the state of the Protection Source

options.name: timeout
options.description: Wait time in seconds while registering/updating source.

options.name: update_source
options.description: Switch determines whether to update the existing source.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Switch determines if SSL Validation should be enabled.

options.name: vmware_type
options.description: Specifies the entity type such as C(VCenter) if the environment is C(VMware).
